svg.aria-label: Three cascades added up: cascade 0, 250 m, holds waves from 250 m to 6.2 m, the swell and the sea; cascade 1, 37 m, holds 6.2 m to 1.2 m, the chop on it; cascade 2, 7 m, holds 1.2 m and shorter, the ripples on that. Their sum is the sea.
